Sun-AC: You shine here — vitality and self-confidence rise, and others see you as a leader.
Sun-DC: Partnerships here are warm and visible; you may attract confident, dominant people or step into the spotlight through others.
Sun-MC: A strong line for recognition — career visibility, authority, and public achievement are amplified here.
Sun-IC: Home and identity feel anchored here; a strong sense of roots and inner confidence, sometimes at the cost of public ambition.
Moon-AC: Emotions run close to the surface — you feel, and are perceived, as nurturing, moody, or instinctively responsive.
Moon-DC: You draw emotionally intuitive or nurturing people into your life, and relationships take on a caretaking quality.
Moon-MC: Public life is tied to the mood of the crowd; changeable, people-facing careers thrive here.
Moon-IC: A deeply domestic line — home, family, and emotional security are central themes here.
Mercury-AC: You come across as curious, quick-witted, and communicative; ideas flow easily.
Mercury-DC: Relationships here are built on conversation and shared ideas — good for negotiation, teaching, or intellectual partnership.
Mercury-MC: A natural line for writing, media, teaching, and business — your voice carries in public life.
Mercury-IC: Home is filled with talk, study, and mental activity; a good line for working from home or writing.
Venus-AC: Charm and attractiveness rise — you feel more at ease in your own skin, and others find you appealing.
Venus-DC: One of the classic lines for romance — partnerships form easily and relationships tend to be affectionate and harmonious.
Venus-MC: Career success through charm, art, diplomacy, or aesthetics; public image is softened and well-liked.
Venus-IC: Home feels beautiful and peaceful; a strong line for domestic happiness and comfort.
Mars-AC: Energy and drive are heightened — you act boldly, sometimes impatiently, and assert yourself more directly.
Mars-DC: Relationships here run hot — passion and conflict both intensify; partners may be assertive or combative.
Mars-MC: Ambition and competitive drive fuel career progress; a demanding but energizing line for achievement.
Mars-IC: Home life can feel charged or restless; useful for tackling projects, but tension at home is common.
Jupiter-AC: Confidence, optimism, and a sense of expansion — this is a lucky, feel-good line for personal growth.
Jupiter-DC: Relationships bring growth and generosity; you may meet mentors, teachers, or generous partners.
Jupiter-MC: One of the best lines for career success — opportunity, recognition, and expansion in public life.
Jupiter-IC: Home and family life feel abundant and secure; a comfortable, optimistic base.
Saturn-AC: Life feels more serious and effortful here; discipline builds real, lasting strength, but ease is scarce.
Saturn-DC: Relationships take on weight and responsibility — commitment is possible, but so is loneliness or restriction.
Saturn-MC: A classic line for hard-won career achievement through discipline, structure, and time.
Saturn-IC: Home life feels weighed down by duty or isolation, but can build a durable, self-reliant foundation.
Uranus-AC: Life feels unpredictable and freeing — you're more likely to break patterns and surprise yourself.
Uranus-DC: Relationships are unconventional, exciting, and prone to sudden change; freedom matters more than stability.
Uranus-MC: Career takes unexpected turns — good for innovation and reinvention, less so for stability.
Uranus-IC: Home life is unsettled or nontraditional; a good line for radical independence, not for roots.
Neptune-AC: Boundaries soften — you feel, and appear, dreamy, artistic, or elusive; inspiration is high, clarity is low.
Neptune-DC: Relationships feel idealized or fated, but can blur into illusion — a line for soulmates and for deception alike.
Neptune-MC: Public image is idealized or hard to pin down; excellent for creative or spiritual work, risky for anything needing a clear reputation.
Neptune-IC: Home feels dreamy and porous — a good line for creative retreat, but roots may feel unstable or hard to define.
Pluto-AC: Life feels intense and transformative — you come across as powerful, and personal reinvention is likely.
Pluto-DC: Relationships run deep and can become consuming; power struggles and profound bonds both live on this line.
Pluto-MC: Career ambition intensifies — this line can bring real power, but also public intensity and scrutiny.
Pluto-IC: Home and family history surface with force; a line for deep psychological work and generational transformation.
